definitions.explanation: A fire-resistant door installed in buildings to prevent the spread of fire and smoke between sections. Required by building codes in many structures.

examples.japanese: {防火扉|ぼうかとびら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{閉|し}めて→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧おいて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please keep the fire door closed at all times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{防火扉|ぼうかとびら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自動的|じどうてき}→自動的：25589_jidouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{閉|し}まる→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧。
examples.english: When a fire breaks out, the fire doors close automatically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{避難訓練|ひなんくんれん}→避難訓練：28230_hinankunren⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧、{防火扉|ぼうかとびら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During the evacuation drill, we were warned not to place objects in front of the fire doors.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{防火|ぼうか}→防火：21169_bouka⟧ (fire prevention/fireproofing) + ⟦{扉|とびら}→扉：04494_tobira⟧ (door). Found in apartment buildings, offices, schools, and commercial buildings throughout Japan. Japanese building codes ({建築基準法|けんちくきじゅんほう}) require fire doors in structures above a certain size.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防火扉|ぼうかとびら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: to close the fire door
- {防火扉|ぼうかとびら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作動|さどう}→作動：11692_sadou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the fire door activates
- {防火扉|ぼうかとびら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧: fire door inspection
- {防火扉|ぼうかとびら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: in front of the fire door

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{防火|ぼうか}→防火：21169_bouka⟧: fire prevention; fireproofing
- {防火壁|ぼうかへき}: firewall (physical wall in a building)
- ⟦{非常口|ひじょうぐち}→非常口：07045_hijouguchi⟧: emergency exit
- ⟦{避難経路|ひなんけいろ}→避難経路：07138_hinankeiro⟧: evacuation route
